function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Use for reading Swift source, specs, configs, or any project file.

path.description: Absolute or ~/ path to the file.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file, creating or overwriting it.

function.name: bash_exec
function.description: Run a shell command and return stdout + stderr. Timeout 30s. Use for one-off commands not covered by specialized tools.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List files in a directory, optionally filtered by extension.

function.name: grep_codebase
function.description: Search for a pattern across files, returning file:line matches.

pattern.description: Regex or literal string to search.

path.description: Directory or file to search. Defaults to invocation directory.

extension.description: Restrict to files with this extension, e.g. 'swift'.

function.name: swift_diagnostics
function.description: Type-check a Swift source file using the current Xcode toolchain and return compiler errors and warnings. Use after writing or modifying Swift code to verify it compiles. Faster than a full build.

path.description: Path to the .swift file to type-check.

function.name: swift_build
function.description: Run `swift build` (or `xcodebuild`) in a project directory and return compiler output. Use to verify a full package builds after making changes.

cwd.description: Project root containing Package.swift. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: swift_test
function.description: Run Swift package tests, optionally filtered to a specific test name or suite.

cwd.description: Project root. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: git_diff
function.description: Show the current working tree diff, or a diff for a specific file. Use to review what has changed before committing or reporting.

path.description: Optional file path to diff. Omit for full working tree diff.

staged.description: Show staged (--cached) diff instead of unstaged. Default false.

cwd.description: Git repo root. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: git_status
function.description: Show the current git status: modified, staged, and untracked files.

cwd.description: Git repo root. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: sdk_search
function.description: Search Apple platform SDK .swiftinterface files for a type, protocol, function, or conformance. Returns ground-truth API signatures from the installed Xcode SDK. Use to verify an API exists, find its exact signature, or check conformances before writing code.

pattern.description: Regex or literal string to search for, e.g. 'MIDIClientCreate' or 'protocol Sendable'.

framework.description: Optional framework name to narrow the search, e.g. 'CoreMIDI', 'SwiftUI', 'Combine'. Omit to search all frameworks.

max_results.description: Maximum matching lines to return. Default 40.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo and return titles, URLs, and snippets. Use for looking up Swift documentation, Apple developer docs, swift.org proposals, or Stack Overflow. Prefer sdk_search for API existence checks — use web_search for conceptual questions or official docs.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'Swift SE-0296 async main' or 'CoreMIDI MIDISendEventList macOS 14'.

max_results.description: Number of results to return. Default 8.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch the text content of a URL. Use for reading a specific Swift Evolution proposal, Apple docs page, or GitHub file. Returns plain text (HTML stripped).

function.name: tuist_generate
function.description: Run `tuist generate` to create or update the Xcode project from the Tuist manifest (Project.swift / Workspace.swift) in the given directory.

path.description: Directory containing the Tuist manifest. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: tuist_install
function.description: Run `tuist install` to fetch and resolve Swift Package dependencies declared in the Tuist manifest.

path.description: Directory containing the Tuist manifest. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: tuist_lint
function.description: Run `tuist lint project` to validate the Tuist manifest for errors and warnings without generating the project.

path.description: Directory containing the Tuist manifest. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: tuist_graph
function.description: Run `tuist graph` to emit the project dependency graph as JSON or dot format. Useful for understanding module dependencies before refactoring.

path.description: Directory containing the Tuist manifest. Defaults to invocation directory.

function.name: api_docs_fetch
function.description: Fetch REST API reference documentation from a URL. Auto-detects OpenAPI/Swagger JSON specs (tries common spec paths if a root URL is given) and returns structured endpoint summaries with methods, parameters, and response codes. Optionally filters to a single endpoint path. Falls back to plain text for non-spec URLs. Prefer JSON spec URLs over YAML — YAML is not parsed.

url.description: Root URL of the API or a direct link to an OpenAPI JSON spec, e.g. 'https://api.example.com' or 'https://api.example.com/openapi.json'.

endpoint.description: Optional path filter, e.g. '/users/{id}'. Returns only endpoints whose path contains this string.
